finding.description: R18 seven facets treated two examples as separate atomic obligations and promoted an explanatory no-new-Gate caveat to a prospective operational obligation; IM43-03 combined two independently falsifiable checks

reconciled_candidates.title: Actual selected public-entrypoint invocation
preconditions: Evidence claims that selected functionality is supported
reconciled_candidates.requirement: The claimed supported implementation must distinguish an actually selected invocation from source-present, exported, imported, initialized, or loaded components
reconciled_candidates.negative_witness: A hook is present and registered but routing never selects it; support cannot be claimed

reconciled_candidates.title: Observable public contract behavior beyond invocation
preconditions: Material public entrypoint was actually selected and invoked
reconciled_candidates.requirement: Actual selected invocation alone does not establish the promised observable contract outcome; record behavioral evidence or leave missing proof unqualified
reconciled_candidates.negative_witness: The selected hook is invoked but outputs the wrong contract result; the integration claim remains unsupported
reconciled_candidates.not_universal: No mandatory full release-wide E2E for leaf changes

reconciled_candidates.title: Repair composition OR disclose missing integration evidence
preconditions: An implementation claims selected feature support
Only import/activation evidence exists without selected contract execution
reconciled_candidates.requirement: Choose real composition repair OR an honest NOT_PROVEN/NOT_RUN disclosure; disclosure is not itself proof of feature support
reconciled_candidates.negative_witness: An implementation claims supported with no selected routing evidence and neither repair nor qualification
reconciled_candidates.source_anchor: repair the real composition or state the missing integration evidence honestly
reconciled_candidates.not_universal: No requirement to force a repair rather than truthfully disclose missing integration evidence

source.anchor: repair the real composition or state the missing integration evidence honestly

reconciled_candidates.title: Testing/Integration owner alone issues executable proof
preconditions: Executable proof of the material selected public path is necessary
reconciled_candidates.requirement: Implementation-quality evidence categorization does not create executable-proof or release certification authority; the applicable Testing/Integration owner owns that evidence
reconciled_candidates.negative_witness: A Builder promotes loaded-source evidence to PASS of a different Testing owner without actual selected contract verification
reconciled_candidates.source_anchor: Testing/Integration owner alone issues the executable proof
reconciled_candidates.not_universal: Do not invent a new Gate or change ownership of Release/Hidden

source.anchor: Testing/Integration owner alone issues the executable proof

reconciled_candidates.title: Clean installed public entrypoint when packaging seam is material
preconditions: There is a shipped public package/plugin entrypoint
The installed-package/build dependency or import seam is material for the claim
reconciled_candidates.requirement: Include a representative clean installed public-entrypoint check for the material seam; a workspace-only import/compile success is not enough
reconciled_candidates.negative_witness: Workspace test passes, clean installed public consumer fails to import required dependency
reconciled_candidates.source_anchor: include it where the public packaging seam is material
reconciled_candidates.not_universal: No unconditional installed-package/large E2E requirement for nonpublic or immaterial seams

source.anchor: include it where the public packaging seam is material

scope_guard_metadata.source_sentence: These are explanatory evidence categories, not new workflow/Gate states.
scope_guard_metadata.behavior: Do not infer an independent state transition or new release gate; this limits what other facet claims can mean

r18_to_r19_mapping.reason: SOURCE_PRESENT is a nonqualifying example, not an independent rule
EXPORTED_OR_LOADED is a parallel nonqualifying example
Actually selected invocation and observable correct behavior can fail separately; independently falsifiable
Explanatory no-new-Gate caveat is metadata, not a newly created operational proof obligation
Conditional disjunctive repair OR honest disclosure, not two mandatory repairs
Reaffirms the existing Testing/Integration proof ownership; not a novel Gate
Only required when installed public packaging seam is materially relevant

review_negative_scenarios.premise: Import-only, repair absent, honest missing-integration disclosure
Import-only, no repair and no disclosure, yet support claimed
Implementation Quality claims Testing executable PASS based only on import
Material installed package entrypoint breaks after workspace PASS
Someone treats SOURCE_PRESENT as new canonical Gate state

bounds.qualifying_statement: This is source-faithfulness and scope correction, not normative approval or executable-path proof
